jobs.title: Product Manager, Wet Goods (CONTRACT)
jobs.jd_full:
We have been alerted to the existence of a fraudster impersonating MANSCAPED as a hiring manager or HR representative. This impersonator is utilizing an email address with the domain manscapedjobs.com or manscapedcareers.com and is making fraudulent offers for our open jobs. Contact from MANSCAPED will only ever come from someone with a manscaped.com email address.

This is a scam targeting a number of companies, us included. If you receive any of these types of messages, we recommend that you don’t respond with any information and that you block and report those users.

  • The MANSCAPED Team


Who We Are - MANSCAPED® is a leading men’s grooming and lifestyle consumer brand on a mission to introduce and elevate a whole new self-care routine for men. What began as the category creator of below-the-waist grooming has quickly evolved into a global omnichannel powerhouse available around the world on manscaped.com, Amazon, and in major retailers including Target®, Walmart, and Best Buy. As a company, we’re more than just ball jokes (though, rest assured, there’s plenty of those). We proudly uphold seven core values – accountability, authenticity, collaboration, fun, humility, inclusivity, and innovation – which define our brand identity and drive our success. As a people-centric employer brand, we are deeply committed to fostering the growth, happiness, and holistic well-being of each individual on our team.

Who We’re Looking For - This contract position will coordinate with the Director, Product Management for Wet Goods and support category ownership for new formulation product lines. The engagement will focus on new formula development, claims substantiation, scale-up of new products, and launch calendar support. Please note, this is a 4-month contract role covering a maternity leave.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the execution of new product development programs within a personal grooming category in the MANSCAPED® portfolio, ensuring projects progress according to established timelines, stage gate requirements, and launch objectives.
  • Translate approved product concepts and innovation briefs into actionable development plans, partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure project requirements, consumer needs, and business objectives are carried through the development process.
  • Drive product development and scale-up execution, including formula development coordination, claims testing, packaging development, artwork initiation, technical transfer activities, and production readiness to support successful commercialization.
  • Manage product costing and business case support, including COGs development, gross margin analysis, financial tracking, and maintenance of approved pricing recommendations throughout the development process.
  • Track and communicate project status to the PD team, senior leadership and cross-functional teams, proactively identifying risks, escalating issues, and coordinating mitigation plans to maintain project timelines and launch readiness.
  • Partner closely with PMO, Design, Marketing, QA, Regulatory, Packaging, Operations, and Channel teams to ensure the successful and timely execution of product launches. Facilitate alignment across stakeholders and drive follow-through on key deliverables.
  • Provide strong organization and tracking support for Product Development and Packaging teams, maintaining project documentation, timelines, action items, and progress reporting across multiple initiatives.
  • Other duties as required

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in executional product development and category ownership role  
  • Proven expertise in overseeing the entire lifecycle of Product Development within personal grooming category 
  • Process-driven mentality, with technical skill set in formula development 
  • Working knowledge of MS project, Asana (or equivalent project management system), and Specification systems 
  • Proven experience supporting a successful product launch  
  • Proven ability to create and execute comprehensive launch calendars aligned with MANSCAPED® roadmap, while effectively identifying opportunities for portfolio optimization  
  • Strong leadership in new product development execution, including overseeing formula development, claims testing, packaging design, artwork initiation, and production, while ensuring accurate cost-of-goods analysis and financial justification 
  • Ability to communicate project statuses and risks effectively to senior leadership and cross-functional teams, facilitating resolution of obstacles and implementation of risk mitigation plans, while maintaining a pulse on industry trends and competitive landscape to drive category leadership and brand perspective 
  • Collaborative, resourceful, ability to learn quickly and adapt to an evolving atmosphere  
Compensation Range
$85—$85 USD

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Basketball Products
jobs.jd_full:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com

The Role - Principal Product Manager, Basketball Products

The Genius Sports Product Team is looking for an exceptional Principal Product Manager to lead our basketball product suite.  As part of the Data & AI product team, you will work with leading global basketball leagues and federations (e.g., NBA, WNBA, NCAA, FIBA, and others) to build, enhance, and maintain the products that capture, process, and deliver basketball data and insights to teams, leagues, media, and betting partners around the world.

You will own the full basketball product suite — AI-driven/automated eventing, Performance Studio enhancements, Next Generation Stats & insights, and Rich data graphics/visualizations — across the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through build, launch, and ongoing growth and improvement. This is an opportunity to shape how basketball data and analytics are captured and experienced across the industry defining the modern language of sport.  You will be working at the intersection of computer vision, real-time data collection, and advanced sports analytics.

The ideal candidate has strong basketball domain experience and is seasoned at delivering modern, data-driven B2B SaaS products, is comfortable owning a diverse product portfolio, and can move fluidly between deep technical/data conversations and strategic, executive-level discussions. You will define and evangelize a clear product roadmap, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes using both qualitative and quantitative data.

What You Will Own:

As the Senior Product Manager, Basketball, you will be responsible for a suite of basketball products spanning the full data and analytics value chain:

  • Basketball Events Feeds – Real-time and post-game basketball events feeds used by leagues, broadcasters, and downstream partners.
  • Basketball Statistics Feeds – Core and advanced basketball statistics feeds that power team, player, and league-level analysis.
  • Performance Studio – Driving a roadmap of continual improvements to our player and team performance analytics platform, including new metrics, workflows, and user experience improvements.
  • Next Generation Stats & Visualizations – Development of next-generation basketball statistics, tracking-derived metrics, and data visualizations that differentiate Genius Sports in the market.

Job Responsibilities:

Build, Maintain, and Grow the Genius Basketball Product Suite

  • Understand customer needs across leagues, teams, media, and betting partners; develop requirements and drive delivery of basketball events feeds, statistics feeds, Performance Studio, and Next Generation stats/visualizations.
  • Own the product lifecycle end-to-end — from ideation, discovery, and validation through build, launch, and post-launch growth and iteration — for each product in the basketball portfolio.
  • Define and evangelize a clear, prioritized product roadmap for basketball products, and communicate it consistently to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data operations, and business teams to ensure basketball product initiatives are delivered on time and on budget.
  • Provide strategic direction on data-informed, long-term investment opportunities for the basketball portfolio, evaluating tradeoffs and prioritizing in consultation with cross-divisional partners.
  • Balance investment across the basketball product portfolio across three horizons - Now/Horizon 1 (0-12 months), Next/Horizon 2 (12-36 months), and Future/Horizon 3 (36+ months)), ensuring a healthy mix of incremental improvement and longer-term innovation.
  • Define KPIs that drive business results for basketball products, build dashboards to measure performance, and make data-driven decisions using both qualitative and quantitative analysis.
  • Partner with commercial, marketing, and operations teams to drive efficient, effective go-to-market motions and continuously gather feedback from leagues, teams, and media/betting partners and translate it into product requirements.
  • Stay current on basketball analytics trends, computer vision tracking technology, and competitor offerings to keep the basketball product suite at the forefront of the industry.

Position Requirements:

  • 7-10 years of relevant product management experience.
  • Strong basketball domain knowledge/expertise.
  • Product management experience building B2B SaaS or other relevant data feeds/ applications: understanding functional requirements and building for scale.
  • Strong grasp of product lifecycle mechanics: discovery, analysis, defining and driving OKRs, ideation, prioritization, and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Experience owning multiple related products or a product portfolio simultaneously, balancing competing priorities across a suite of offerings.
  • Extensive background collaborating with UX design partners to build intuitive, user-first experiences.
  • Strong background in BI and/or analytics required; experience working on data-oriented or sports statistics products preferred.
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership, participating in the sales cycle, and handling sensitive, critical issues.
  • Experience working in and delivering products or services in an agile/lean environment, including backlog management (user stories, epics, and bugs).
  • Proficiency in gathering and transforming product requirements into a practical, prioritized product roadmap.
  • Prior experience as a basketball statistician, analyst, or a strong passion for basketball and basketball analytics is a plus.
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Basketball events feeds, statistics feeds, Performance Studio, and Next Generation stats/visualizations operate as a coherent, well-sequenced portfolio rather than disconnected efforts.
  • Product decisions are consistently grounded in customer needs and data to drive our Genius revenue streams, with clear KPIs tracked and acted on.
  • Cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data ops, commercial) trust the roadmap and rely on the PM as the source of truth for basketball product direction.
  • Leagues, teams, and media/betting partners see measurable improvement in the quality, timeliness, and depth of basketball data and insights.
  • The basketball product suite is recognized internally and externally as a differentiator for Genius Sports in the market.

The salary for this role is based on an annualized salary range of $230,000 - $270,000. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group’s benefits plan.

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports.

Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Core Integrations & API
jobs.jd_full:
The Position

CallRail is looking for a Product Manager to join our team that supports our core integrations, public API and webhooks products.

This is a build role. You’ll ship net-new integrations with platforms our customers depend on — automotive and healthcare tools, scheduling systems, workflow platforms like Zapier — and you’ll deepen the ones we already have. You’ll also own the shared service and framework those integrations run on, and the developer-facing API and webhook surface that thousands of customers and partners build on top of.

The other half of the job is keeping the ecosystem healthy. Integrations break in ways ad campaigns don’t, and you’ll be the person who decides what gets fixed first. That means working shoulder to shoulder with Support, Sales, and Marketing — they hear about problems before dashboards do, they know which integration is blocking a deal, and they need you to tell them what’s coming and when.

This role suits a hands-on, technically fluent PM who wants to ship real integrations, cares about customer product experience, and works in an environment where AI is a daily tool rather than a talking point.

What You’ll Do

Build and deepen integrations

  • Ship net-new core integrations — new verticals like automotive and healthcare, scheduling and workflow platforms, and the partners our roadmap calls for next.
  • Deepen existing integrations past MVP: fill functional gaps, expand data coverage, and make the ones customers already rely on genuinely good.
  • Own the shared service and framework every integration inherits — data sync, authentication, error handling, and retries — and the tooling that makes the next integration cheaper to build than the last.
  • Own the integrations UI and library: how customers discover, connect, configure, and troubleshoot what we’ve built.

Own the API and webhooks

  • Own CallRail’s public API and webhooks as a product, not a byproduct: new capabilities, versioning strategy, deprecation paths, and the developer experience around them.
  • Drive parity between our API and webhooks so developers get consistent data and behavior regardless of how they consume it.
  • Own API documentation, the developer dashboard, and the administration and billing experience for API access.
  • Define and monitor the health metrics developers actually feel — latency, error rates, rate-limit behavior, webhook delivery reliability — and act on them.

Prioritize and triage

  • Own the integrations bug queue. Triage incoming issues, and make the reliability work that keeps the ecosystem healthy visible and scheduled rather than invisible and endless.
  • Make the call on sequencing net-new work against fixes and migrations, and be able to explain that call to anyone who asks.
  • Close the loop with Support — build the intake path that turns ticket patterns into prioritized work, and give them the answers and workarounds they need in the meantime.
  • Keep Sales and Marketing ahead of the roadmap: what’s shipping, what’s fixed, what’s still broken, and what they can confidently sell and promote.

Cross-functional

  • Write clear, actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria with real technical context and edge cases identified up front.
  • Lead discovery with customers, developers, and internal teams to validate problems before scoping solutions.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience on launches, enablement, and adoption.
  • Represent core integrations and the API in planning cycles and cross-functional initiatives.

What You’ll Need

  • 3-5 years of product management experience, including meaningful time on integrations, APIs, developer tools, or platform-oriented work.
  • Background in marketing tech, communications tools, or call tracking ecosystems.
  • A track record of actually shipping B2B SaaS integrations end to end — not just governing a platform others built on.
  • Strong technical fluency. You read API documentation comfortably, reason about data models and auth flows, understand webhooks and event delivery semantics, and can scope edge cases with engineers without needing a translator.
  • Hands-on experience with public or partner APIs — REST, OAuth, versioning, rate limiting, pagination, and webhook reliability patterns.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools (Claude or similar) in your actual day-to-day product work.
  • Comfort working directly with Support, Sales, and Marketing — turning their signal into prioritized work and keeping them informed without being asked twice.
  • Comfort with the unglamorous half of integration work: bugs, migrations, and reliability — and the judgment to prioritize it against net-new.
  • Ability to prioritize clearly across business goals, customer needs, and technical feasibility, and to explain your reasoning to both engineers and executives.
  • Experience in Agile teams working closely with engineers and designers.
  • Excellent written communication. Integration decisions live or die by how well they’re documented.
  • Familiarity with tools we use: Jira, Confluence, Miro, Looker, Fullstory, Figma.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or scaling a developer platform, API program, or developer portal.
  • Experience with vertical software ecosystems — automotive, healthcare, home services, or legal.
  • Experience with MCP, agent frameworks, or designing APIs intended for AI consumption.

Working With AI at CallRail

AI is core to how our product team operates, and we expect it to be core to how you operate. We use Claude across discovery, spec writing, data analysis, prototyping, and internal tooling, and we’re actively building AI capabilities into the product itself. In this role you will:

  • Use AI daily as a working tool — clustering support tickets to find the real bug patterns, drafting and pressure-testing specs, exploring API data, and building throwaway scripts and prototypes to answer questions faster than a meeting could.
  • Build your own leverage rather than waiting for it — writing Claude skills, agents, and internal workflows that make you and your team faster.
  • Think about CallRail’s platform as something AI agents will consume, not just humans. MCP servers, agent-friendly API design, and tool-calling patterns are increasingly part of what a modern integrations platform is expected to offer, and you’ll help shape our point of view there.
  • Stay genuinely current. The tooling changes every few months, and we want someone curious enough to keep up and pragmatic enough to know when a new tool actually helps.

We’re looking for evidence that you’ve already changed how you work because of these tools — not just enthusiasm about them.

If you do not meet all the requirements listed, we still encourage you to apply! No job description is perfect, and we may also have another opportunity that aligns with your skills and experience.

Additional Perks

  • Healthcare (one option covered at 100% for employees), Dental & Vision Coverage
  • Competitive HSA with company matching
  • Paid parental leave
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • 401K options with company dollar-for-dollar match
  • Employee stock options available from day one
  • $2,000 annual educational allowance
  • Catered lunch every Tuesday * an in-office perk
  • MARTA transportation or office parking expenses covered
  • Employee charitable donation company match, up to $500 annually
  • Regular company outings and events
  • Hybrid work options with $500 office stipend to set up your home office
  • Designated bike storage

Learn more:https://www.callrail.com/about/

You Are Welcome Here

CallRail understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Continuous adoption of AI technologies is essential to this role. You will be expected to leverage AI platforms to streamline operations, solve complex problems, and stay ahead of industry benchmarks.

This position is based out of our Atlanta office. Through December 2026, employees are expected to work in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Beginning in January 2027, CallRail will transition to a 3.5-day hybrid work model. Employees will work in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, with Wednesdays alternating bi-weekly between remote and in-office. Fridays will remain remote.

jobs.title: Contract: Senior Producer (project manager / delivery manager)
jobs.jd_full:
About Portable

We are Australia’s leading innovation partner for public good, developing technology and design solutions that power the public and the people who serve it. We seek out areas of acute social need and work with government agencies, nonprofit organisations, and socially minded businesses to make transformational change.

There are 65+ of us: researchers, strategists, designers, technologists and producers, working from our head office in Collingwood and remotely from co-working spaces and homes across Australia.

About this role

We have an immediate gap in one of our delivery teams and need an experienced contract producer to help us cover it. We’re also using this as a chance to build an ongoing pool of contract producers we can call on when the need arises: covering a capacity gap, supporting a team through a busy patch, or adding delivery leadership at short notice.

We’re keen to hear from people who can start immediately or relatively soon, as well as people who’d like to be considered for future opportunities.

We use the title “producer” at Portable. If you know this kind of work as project management, delivery management, or delivery leadership, this is the same role: it’s about managing scope, budget, timelines, and the people and partners involved in delivering a project, rather than producing film, video, or animation.

The kind of project you join will depend on what’s needed at the time. Portable delivers digital products, large-scale website design and development, strategic design and service design work, AI tool development, and a range of other project types (check out portable.com.au for examples of our work).

Then there’s you

You’re an experienced producer, project manager, or delivery manager with significant experience behind you: typically 8 or more years delivering technology, design or research projects. You’ve done enough of these engagements to know how to read a new team, client and project quickly.

You’re comfortable leading delivery independently: picking up a brief, asking the right questions, and getting moving without waiting to be told what to do next. You’re a problem-solver at heart and can apply your experience to new contexts and project types, even if you haven’t worked with them before. And you’re genuinely comfortable with feedback: giving it as well as receiving it, from whoever on the team has something useful to say, because you know that’s how good work gets made under pressure.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in quickly onboarding into new contexts, environments and tools: you don’t need months of ramp-up to be useful, and you’re comfortable getting oriented on the job.
  • A natural ability to work across diverse teams and stakeholders: you build relationships quickly, adapt your communication style to your audience, and know how to get the best out of people in different contexts.
  • The ability to work, and lead work, independently: you’re confident picking up a brief and driving it forward with minimal oversight.
  • Comfort with feedback, in both directions: you’re open to input from anyone on the team, not just people in your exact role, because you’re as invested in the quality of the work as we are.
  • Significant experience (typically 8 or more years) delivering digital research, design or technology projects, ideally with significant budgets ($500k+).
  • Confident stakeholder communication, and the judgement to know when to escalate.
  • Comfort managing scope, budget and timelines under real time pressure.
  • Experience across agile and waterfall methodologies, and the judgement to know when each is useful.
  • Familiarity with common delivery tools (Jira, Asana and similar), and the flexibility to pick up whatever a new team is already using.
  • Experience delivering projects for government and/or not-for-profits.

What this can look like

Because this is an ongoing pool rather than one fixed role, the work varies depending on what’s needed at the time. You might be:

  • Leading delivery on one or more projects end to end, keeping scope, budget and timelines on track.
  • Stepping into an existing team partway through a project, and getting up to speed fast.
  • Writing or refining a statement of work, tracking assumptions, risks and dependencies.
  • Running stand-ups, workshops and client check-ins.
  • Coordinating research, design and development inputs so the right work happens at the right time.
  • Providing extra delivery leadership or capacity during a busy period or a gap in the team.
  • Supporting in identifying, scoping and bidding for new business opportunities.

Engagement details

Engagement length, hours and rate vary depending on what’s needed: anywhere from a short burst of support to a few months of work. We’re especially keen to hear from people who could start immediately or at short notice, though we also want to hear from people available further down the track.

Preferably you’d be able to work hybrid from our Melbourne or Adelaide office, but we’re also open to other remote options within Australia.

How to apply

We’re committed to building a diverse and equitable pool of contractors. People from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

To be considered, please send us:

jobs.title: Product Manager 1
jobs.jd_full:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating, licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured data that is both self-sourced and from third party content providers. The Content teams report to the Chief Content Officer and have strategy, product management, content operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing a rapid growth cycle across all content sets, including the Broker Research team. We value and uphold transparency, trust and accountability in our relationships within the team and with external and internal stakeholders.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Product Manager I to join the Broker Research team. The PM I must have working knowledge of investment research, including the business models and client use cases for research content and associated data. The focus of this role will be the integration and maintenance of third-party content in AlphaSense. Additional responsibilities will include the need to continuously analyze and enhance processes by working with our agile teams. The candidate must also be capable of articulating and delivering a vision for research and data on AlphaSense.

Who You Are:

  • 3-5 years’ experience in financial services with a specific focus on broker research.

  • A strong knowledge of broker data, content, and metadata.

  • Content delivery experience using iterative / agile development methodologies.

  • A proven track record of delivering content from initial engagement to release.

  • A superior ability to set priorities, stay focused and meet deadlines.

  • Experience working with distributed teams.

  • Existing relationships with broker research departments and key third-party distribution vendors.

  • Strong analytical skills and outstanding attention to detail.

  • B2B SaaS and/or enterprise software application company experience.

  • Solid experience with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace products (Excel, Word, Sheets, etc)

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for the end-to-end integration of third-party content and data feeds.

  • Work with external and internal stakeholders to create detailed requirements for broker data and content.

  • Collect product & workflow enhancement requests from brokers & internal stakeholders.

  • Applying agile development methodology and working iteratively with engineers and various stakeholders to define scope and deliver features and improvements rapidly, while iterating to make improvements.

  • Work with other members of the broker research team, continuously analyze our processes and tools to identify gaps and areas of improvement.

  • Manage and maintain strong broker and independent research relationships with key decision makers; including product, business, technology, and operations teams.

  • Project manage partnership initiatives with research providers.

  • Create and manage a project roadmap by working with development teams to understand and optimize costs, benefits, and timelines for all aspects of implementation.

  • Contributing to the successful launch of content into the market, including the creation of announcements, marketing collateral, documentation, user training and internal training.

  • Track industry trends and deliver competitive intelligence to better evolve product vision.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

jobs.title: Vice Chair Office, Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Vice Chair Office sets Stripe’s strategy across government relations, public affairs, and policy, and partners closely with publishing, philanthropy, and other external-facing programs — together, the parts of the company that shape how Stripe shows up in the world beyond the product itself, and that increasingly shape the long-term environment Stripe operates in.

We translate the Vice Chair’s external-impact priorities into a clear portfolio of programs, with disciplined decisions and coordinated execution behind them. The portfolio spans enduring work (policy strategy, government-relations cadence, external stakeholder relationships) and time-bound programs (major convenings, publishing initiatives, campaigns). As a result, the Policy team is one of our closest and largest cross-functional partners — much of what we do is built and run in close coordination with the policy team, not just adjacent to it. We’re a small, high-output team working on questions with a long time horizon, and the work changes shape as the portfolio grows.

What you’ll do

This role works closely with the Chief of Staff on strategy and operations for the Vice Chair Office. You’ll help design how this cross-functional portfolio runs, and you’ll own individual programs end-to-end. Some weeks that means building a planning process from scratch; other weeks it means running a convening or driving a cross-functional initiative to a decision. You’ll work at every altitude — from shaping how the team plans and prioritizes, to being in the room for the execution details that make a program land well.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Chief of Staff to translate the Vice Chair’s priorities into a clear portfolio of programs across policy, public affairs, publishing, and external partnerships
  • Design and run the team’s operating rhythm — the planning, review, and decision forums that keep a fast-moving, cross-functional portfolio aligned
  • Own programs end-to-end: frame the objective, build the plan, drive execution, and report on outcomes
  • Build the operational foundations for a growing team — from how work gets prioritized and tracked, to how we define and measure success across a portfolio of programs that don’t share a common metric today
  • Stand up the team’s approach to measurement: define what success looks like per program, run experiments where useful, and track outcomes so the team can tell what’s working
  • Represent the Vice Chair Office in cross-functional settings with comms, policy, legal, finance, and external partners
  • Spot risks and dependencies across the portfolio early and drive them to resolution
  • Take on new projects and ambiguous problems as the portfolio’s priorities shift

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3-5 years experience in strategy, program leadership, or an operating role supporting a senior leader or a complex, cross-functional team
  • A track record of turning ambiguous priorities into a structured plan and driving it through to execution
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with experience preparing materials for senior stakeholders
  • Good judgment about when to make a call yourself and when to escalate
  • Comfort managing several workstreams at once without losing track of the details
  • Impeccable organizational, project management and stakeholder management skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in policy, government relations, public affairs, or a related field
  • Experience working directly with senior executives
  • Experience building a process, program, or team structure from scratch
  • Experience defining success metrics or running experiments for programs that don’t have an obvious, pre-built way to measure impact

jobs.title: Program Manager, Competitive Programs
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Competitive Programs team, which is part of the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategic Programs team, is a new team dedicated to establishing and scaling Stripe’s Competitive Programs capability. Stripe operates in a dynamic and evolving competitive landscape. This role will help Stripe understand market developments and translate competitive insights into actionable guidance for teams and users.

The Competitive Programs team works alongside Market Intelligence to help Stripe identify meaningful threats and opportunities early, mobilize coordinated action across the company in priority situations, and turn market and deal signals into better Product, Marketing, and GTM decisions. We build the competitive operating system—program design, cross-functional coordination, deal-routing mechanisms, visibility, and accountability—while Product, Sales, PMM, Pricing, and other functions retain ownership for decisions and delivery in their domains.

This is a full-stack program manager role. While the initial assignment is Competitive Programs, we are looking for a versatile program manager who can apply the same skills to other high-priority GTM initiatives as the team’s mandate and Stripe’s needs evolve.

What you’ll do

You will lead complex, C-suite level high-priority programs that require Stripe to move quickly and cohesively across functions. Initially, you will:

  • Build the foundations and operating mechanisms to turn ad hoc competitive programs into a repeatable, scalable playbook
  • Run one or more named competitive programs to protect strategic business, close recurring gaps, and pursue opportunities to take share
  • Partner with Stripe’s leadership to execute on initiatives to drive a strategic shift in company culture

You will be successful in this role if you can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear program with the right objectives, owners, decisions, operating cadence, and measures of success. You will be a trusted partner to executive leaders across Sales, Product, Product Operations, Marketing, Market Intelligence, Pricing, Finance & Strategy, and GTM Operations. You will not be expected to make Product roadmap, commercial-policy, or account-strategy decisions yourself; instead, you will ensure the right functional owners are engaged, accountable, and able to make decisions at the pace required.  You will need (1) superior communication skills to work across senior stakeholders from different functions and (2) are someone who thrives when solving complex problems with limited oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Build repeatable Competitive Programs infrastructure that can scale beyond individual competitors—for example, playbooks for deal escalation, commercial guidance, incentives, user-base analysis, regional teardowns, and cross-functional feedback loops.
  • Lead named P0 and P1 competitive programs end-to-end, including defining the program charter, objectives, workplan, milestones, decision forums, and success measures.
  • Establish and run the cross-functional operating cadence for each program; this may include delivery of critical program workstreams including product and regional teardowns, seller enablement, product-gap reviews, GTM plays and executive engagement plans.
  • Coordinate competitive deal-triage and swarm mechanisms for priority opportunities, ensuring each deal has a clear commercial owner, response plan, and access to the required Product, Pricing, Legal, Risk, or executive support.
  • Partner with Market Intelligence to translate competitor, customer, and deal signals into concrete actions for Product, PMM, Sales, and GTM leadership.
  • Create clear, decision-oriented reporting for executive leadership on program health, competitive pipeline, risks, progress against commitments, and recommendations to continue, adjust, elevate, or graduate a program.
  • Own and operationalize company-wide competitive cultural initiatives to shift Stripe’s behavior to be focused on competing fiercely.
  • Build strong, trusted working relationships across functions and levels, while maintaining clear accountability boundaries between central program coordination and functional ownership.
  • Apply the same program-design and execution skills to other strategic GTM priorities over time, as business needs and the team’s mandate evolve.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

You are a strategic, hands-on program leader who is comfortable working in ambiguity and accountable for creating clarity. You can move between executive-level strategy and operational detail, bring disparate groups to a decision, and build mechanisms that outlast the initial program. You are energized by the intersection of market dynamics, competitors, strategy, product, marketing, commercials and deals, and how they all bridge together in a competitive situation.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline. Experience working in a Sales, Marketing, Product, GTM Operations, or other commercial organization.
  • A strong record of leading complex and ambiguous cross-functional programs from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and operational handoff. Experience managing global programs across regions, segments, and product lines.
  • Works well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment.
  • Experience navigating multiple senior stakeholders with differing incentives, priorities, and decision rights.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs, make recommendations, and drive decisions.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to produce well-structured written updates, facilitate senior working sessions, and communicate risks or trade-offs directly.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain an operating cadence across multiple teams, including tracking milestones, dependencies, actions, and escalations.
  • A high degree of ownership, sound judgment, adaptability, and comfort working in a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to diagnose issues, assess program health, and guide prioritization.
  • An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves mentality” paired with a collaborative working style that builds trust.
  • Someone who demonstrates leadership qualities throughout their work – taking ownership of challenges, selflessly supporting their colleagues, and setting the standard for quality in their deliverables

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading competitive programs, strategic account programs, product-launch programs, commercial transformation, or other high-stakes GTM initiatives.
  • Experience working at a B2B technology, enterprise software, fintech, payments, or platform company.
  • Familiarity with competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, sales enablement, pricing, commercial strategy, or product-feedback mechanisms.
  • Experience building a new operating model, program-management function, or repeatable playbook from the ground up.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Product Operations, PMM, Sales, Pricing, Finance & Strategy, and GTM Systems teams.
  • Comfort with SQL, BI tools, or other methods of analyzing pipeline, adoption, revenue, and operational data.

jobs.title: Senior Construction Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW

The Senior Construction Project Manager will be the primary lead for the planning and buildout execution of assigned projects throughout North America. This role will be directly responsible for the oversight and management of all General Contractors, suppliers, and service providers to ensure on-time and on-budget project completion.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the full life-cycle project management of assigned retail projects throughout North America (up to 10 projects per year)
  • Align with Real Estate, Store Design, and leadership to define project milestones and overall schedule
  • Review and assist with negotiation of Landlord Work Letters prior to lease execution
  • Attend and contribute to Landlord Kick-off calls to ensure alignment on LL work and project specific requirements
  • Partner with Store Design and Expeditors to execute proper documents needed to submit through to respective Building Departments.
  • Review and redline Preliminary Design Sets to ensure accurate scope and details, as well as identify long lead materials and project risks
  • Manage the bidding and award process with contractors/vendors
  • Communicate and form relationships with Landlord representatives to kick off construction, identify spatial conditions against lease exhibits and understand requirements for store opening.
  • Create and communicate the Vendor Delivery Schedule (VDS) for coordination of all owner-supplied material in coordination with GC construction schedule
  • Manage and maintain all external vendor relationships throughout the duration of construction
  • Review and approve project Shop Drawings and Submittals
  • Lead weekly OAC calls to review project status with all project stakeholders
  • Review and approve GC Payment Applications and supplier invoices
  • Review and validate potential Change Orders from GC’s and suppliers and provide approval recommendation
  • Partner with Construction Finance Manager to maintain accurate and timely budget forecast

  • Perform periodic site visits to ensure projects are meeting quality and schedule expectations
  • Generate contractor(s) punch lists and monitor their timely completion
  • Support the New Store Opening team during merchandising period

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6-8 years of project management experience in specialty or luxury retail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently in various stages of development
  • Knowledge of labor and material costs, and best practices in the retail construction industry
  • Strong communication skills in both verbal and written format
  • Experience working with Project Management Software (ex. Procore, PlanGrid, etc.)
  • Experienced in working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Proactive, positive, and professional nature
  • Ability to perform tasks with discretion and poise and often confidentiality

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Description

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own AI-driven automation across two connected areas of Precoro’s product: Accounts Payable automation and our new generation of AI agents for procurement document processing.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who has already taken AI features from idea to production and wants to do it again at scale — across thousands of real customer documents every month.

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

Accounts Payable Automation

  • Increase invoice automation: grow the share of invoices entered fully automatically to a target of 70%.

  • Reduce recognition errors: bring down mismatch rates, currently 7% on the US server and 3% on COM.

  • Automate custom recognition prompts, building logic that adapts invoice recognition to individual customers’ requirements based on their support tickets.

  • Grow key adoption metrics: AP Automation adoption among customers who purchased the tariff plan but aren’t yet using it fully, and AP awareness among users who haven’t experienced the automated flow at all.

AI Agents (Document Intelligence)

  • Launch 5 core agents: Intake (creates the purchase request for the user — all they provide is the ask), Purchasing, Matching, Payments, and Data Enrichment.

  • Drive agent adoption, embedding them into customers’ real procurement processes rather than leaving them as optional features.

  • Drive MCP (Model Context Protocol) adoption across the product.

Requirements

  • Previous hands-on experience implementing AI, either:

    • internally, for business process automation — at minimum in reporting or accounting/finance; or

    • in a product context — at minimum automating communications.

  • Practical experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering.

  • A proven track record of shipping AI features into production environments.

  • 2+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role working with B2B SaaS products.

Growth

The scope of this role is a draw on its own — you’d be driving AI automation across one of the highest-volume, highest-impact workflows in the product. Beyond that, there’s a real path to Group Product Manager, based on:

  • Measurable results against the metrics above.

  • Building a team that can sustain and evolve the product, with a process that’s predictable rather than reactive.

Why you’ll love working at Precoro:

  1. Trust-based management: No micromanagement—your ideas and initiatives are always encouraged.

  2. Supportive team culture: You’re not alone, our team is open, honest, and always ready to help.

  3. Reimbursement for professional learning: We invest in your growth through courses, lectures, and more.

  4. Flexible hours: We care about results, not how long you sit at your desk.

  5. 26 days off annually(15 vacation days + 11 public holidays) : Work-life balance is a priority for us.

  6. Medical insurance (after six months)

  7. Unlimited sick leave without requiring a medical certificate. Your health matters most.

  8. Pet-friendly offices in Kyiv: Love your furry friend? Bring them along!

  9. Supporting Ukraine: We proudly assist the Armed Forces and contribute toprojects that bring victory closer.

Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter interview (30–45 minutes)

  2. Interview with a manager (1 hour)

  3. Test task (2–4 hours)

Join a team that values trust, transparency, and open communication. You can read more about Precoro’s values at this link.

We foster an environment where everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive business growth!
